summary: Iteration 25 — validated the two new modules end-to-end: Podcast/Broadcast episodes (admin CRUD, scheduling/gating, publish-now, public page + filters + inline players, bottom nav) and Zoom live classes (mock meeting creation, recording attach with replay window, gated student access). 20/20 backend pytest assertions pass; all UI flows in the request pass. One HIGH security leak found: the public GET /api/class-instances list returns raw docs including zoom_start_url (host start URL) and recording_url, bypassing the gating that GET /api/class-instances/{id} and /recording implement.

critical.issue: Unauthenticated list endpoint returns raw class docs including `zoom_start_url` (Zoom HOST start link) and `recording_url`. Reproduced: anon GET returned zoom_start_url=https://zoom.us/s/mock-... and recording_url=https://example.com/LEAKCHECK.mp4. This bypasses the booking/subscription gate and the replay-expiry check in GET /api/class-instances/{id}/recording (get_instance already strips both fields; list_instances does not). Strip both in list_instances (and any instructor/admin list that is not role-gated).

minor.issue: Any user with an active/trialing subscription can watch a class recording even if they never booked that class (`member` fallback in the auth check). If spec 4.3 means 'students who booked', this is broader than intended — confirm it is deliberate.

publish_at gating uses lexicographic string comparison on ISO timestamps. Works today because all values are stored as UTC +00:00 isoformat, but any doc written with a different offset (or naive) would sort/compare wrongly. Consider storing real datetimes.

issues: 'Schedule release' uses the raw browser datetime-local picker (native mm/dd/yyyy --:-- control) instead of the app's shadcn date/time component — inconsistent with the rest of the design system.
'Add recording' is offered for in-person classes too (Gentle Hatha / Power Yoga). Harmless but may be unintended; consider hiding unless is_recorded/online.

action_items: HIGH: strip zoom_start_url and recording_url from GET /api/class-instances (list_instances) responses — currently leaked to anonymous callers.
Confirm whether active subscribers who never booked should see class recordings (current behaviour allows it).
Replace the native datetime-local 'Schedule release' input in Admin → Broadcast with the shadcn date/time picker.

broadcasts.py publish tick + publish endpoint set notified=True before the pre-fetched doc is checked, so the push fires exactly once — correct.
Admin.jsx is 1617 lines — well over the 700-line guideline; EpisodesManager/BroadcastPane/ClassesPane should be split into separate files.

rca_of_the_issue: routers/scheduling.py get_instance() explicitly pops zoom_start_url and recording_url, but list_instances() (line 331) returns `db.class_instances.find(query, {'_id': 0})` unmodified and has no auth dependency, so both host-only fields ship to any anonymous client of GET /api/class-instances. Repro: create an online class, attach a recording, then GET /api/class-instances?include_cancelled=true with no Authorization header. Mitigation: apply the same field-stripping (ideally a shared `_public_instance()` helper) in list_instances and in any other endpoint returning class_instances documents.
